environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda via API Gateway (HTTP API type, no WAF). The function runs in a VPC with access to the EC2 metadata service (IMDSv1 enabled). No response header policies configured on the API Gateway. The DNS resolver used by the Lambda runtime does not pin resolved addresses, allowing DNS rebinding attacks where a hostname initially resolves to a public IP but subsequently resolves to 169.254.169.254.
